title: 800k Flybuys Points, What's The Best Value I Can Get?
body:
Hey all,
I've got around 400k Flybuys points right now and more coming in. Not sure of the exact number, but I'm expecting somewhere around 800k total. Honestly I have no idea what to do with them.
I just want the best value I can get. I don't want to spend them on a new phone. I'm not a phone guy and I already have a 17 Pro, so tech stuff isn't really needed.
Based in Melbourne. Open to travel, shopping, gift cards, whatever gets the most out of them.
Should I use the 400k now or wait until the rest comes in? And what would you do with around 800k?
Thanks!
